notes: Stratholme (recheck2): the main gate is where Classic had it. QuestieDB_Forever's Anthion Harmon stands at EPL map 26.1,11.3 = world (3367.7, -3379.5) (AreaTable 2279 Stratholme), beside the gate mouths of the Stratholme city WMO (7956012, WMO 21106, placed on map 0 at 3449.7,-3379.7: its street floor meets the terrain at 3349,-3352 / 3358,-3435 / 3377,-3324, z 142); goal I now stops there, not at the WMO's origin 80 yd inside. The reported 48.4,21.8 is the SERVICE entrance in the CLASSIC map frame (Classic EPL rect t 3799.2 b 1218.75 l -2185.4 r -6056.3 -> world 3236.7,-4058.9); this client's map rect differs, so the same spot is Forever map 41.9,15.9. There the gatehouse stratholme_c.wmo (110243 at 3190,-4039) opens onto the ground at 3178,-4033 z 106 (route J) and its tunnel floor (z 109) runs east to 3274,-4078; a collisionwallwmo01 (1719969: an invisible wall 11 x 18 yd, 1.2 yd thick, yaw 107.5) stands across that tunnel at 3238.3,-4060.6 z 105.5, the old portal spot. Whether it is the portal's back stop or a closure is an in-game check. No AreaTrigger for either entrance is in this client's AreaTrigger.db2.
